# TC.Config.SignalID

Source: public `api/` declarations. [All public types and globals](../types.md).

<a id="symbol-TC.Config.SignalID"></a>

### TC.Config.SignalID

Accepted input for SignalID. Unknown fields are refused. registered_signal: An installed signal identity is required. explicit_signal_type: Input signal type must be explicit. Input requires explicit type and name. Output includes explicit type, name, and quality. The default quality is normal. Wildcard permission depends on the role, not general SignalID permission.

### name

Exact prototype or quality identity for the enclosing concept. No localization lookup occurs. At most 256 bytes. NUL is not permitted.

```text
string
```

### quality (optional)

Exact installed quality name. Normalization uses normal when this concept permits omission. At most 256 bytes. NUL is not permitted. Use an installed quality name, not a native object.

```text
string
```

### type

Signal prototype namespace. SignalID and SignalIDBase require an explicit input type.

```text
TC.Config.SignalIDType
```
